info.description:
Generated from the source by cmd/openapi.

Sign in with the account's session token in the `token` header. A bot sends its token as `Authorization: Bot <token>` (or in the `token` header) and reaches only the routes marked `x-bots.allowed`, within its scopes. A `yp.` project token (the yur command line) reaches only routes marked `x-project-token`. Routes whose security includes `{}` open without a token; a token that is sent must be valid, and a bot sends its token there in the `token` header, as the `Authorization` header is not looked at. `x-auth: query` marks sockets that take the token in the `token` query parameter.

A failure answers `{"ok": 0, "detail": "<code>"}`; `x-errors` lists the codes a route can answer with, found in the handler and in the functions it calls, so the list can have codes a given call never meets. Too many requests from one address, token or guest answer 429 `too_many_attempts` with `Retry-After`.
